answer: Bindings are kept in lotus, verified in marble, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the grove check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. The attacker spends 178 dollars and 11 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
